payload.name: pc-contrast-08
payload.description: Pure-logic validator for raw records. Returns {ok, records} where records is the original list when every item is a valid {code, enabled} object (code a 2..5 char string, enabled an exact boolean), otherwise an empty list. No exceptions, no coercion, no I/O, no host calls, no upstream validation assumption.
